record.question: What is 'road mapping' in DSA?
options: A 3D reconstruction of the vascular system.
A tool to measure the distance between two vessels.
An overlay of a mask image onto the fluoroscopic image to guide catheter placement.
A technique to identify the contrast's flow rate.
record.explanation: Answer C: An overlay of a mask image onto the fluoroscopic image to guide catheter placement.. DSA roadmapping overlays a stored contrast-filled vessel image onto live fluoroscopy to guide a catheter. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/mammo; https://www.dicomstandard.org/current. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
